key_findings: HFS of deep Vc induces LTP in Vi neurons; furosemide (KCC2 blockade) reduces LTP magnitude and converts it to LTD in 4/9 neurons.
DHPG (group I mGluR agonist) induces LTP in Vo neurons under control conditions but predominantly LTD during KCC2 blockade with VU0240551.
Furosemide enhances HFS-induced suppression (LTD) of GABAergic inhibitory responses in Vi neurons.
